Starting cards as posted: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (posted 'Set Your Course For Alderaan/The Other Side'), Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (posted 'Oppressive Enforcement & There Is No Try'), Mobilization Points and First Strike; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'CHYBC' dested Come Here You Big Coward (the older Special Edition Effect, not the Reflections III shield); 'Dreadnaught x4' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'U-3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Short Range Fighters' Short-range Fighters; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'I've Lost Artoo' I've Lost Artoo!.

The post says the deck 'has gone 18-2 in tournaments' since August 2000, 'with its only two losses to Mike Raveling'; no event is named, so it is filed as general. The top line says to swap the Omni Box combo for Relentless Pursuit; not applied.
